competitors.label: Competitors
competitors.sort_basis: Score, then number of supporting sources

items.label: Greenly
items.detail: Greenly markets itself as an accessible alternative for SMBs with an intuitive interface, automated data collection, and climate experts. They also raised $52M Series B.

items.label: Aclymate
items.detail: Aclymate is highlighted as a best carbon accounting platform for SMBs, offering user-friendly and affordable tools.

items.label: Persefoni
items.detail: Persefoni has raised $101M Series B, struck strategic partnerships, expanded into Japan, and offers a free tier.

items.label: Eco-Auditor

bands.label: Directly supported
bands.meaning: Stated directly and repeatedly across multiple independent sources.

bands.label: Clearly indicated
bands.meaning: Stated clearly but in few sources, or implied consistently across many.

bands.label: Inferred
bands.meaning: Inferred from context; not directly stated in any single source.

score_scale.note: Three bands, not a continuous scale. The model cannot reliably distinguish a 72 from a 78, so it is not asked to.

removed_fields.reason: A weighted keyword sum clamped at 100. The weights were set when the extractor was gated to dedicated market-report sources; it later scanned all 30 ranked sources, so the sum cleared the clamp on ordinary inputs and the value saturated at 100. The underlying counts replace it.
A 0-100 composite the model wrote with no stated formula. The verdict is the decision and its reason; a number cannot carry that and invited the interface to render it as a hero gauge.

Undefined composite with no metric_definitions entry and no derivation. Variance testing measured it spreading 92 points across five identical runs (8, 100, 100, 94, 100) -- the least reproducible number in the payload, rendered as the largest.
